_doc: THE place to change a voice. Edit describe/seed/refText of one character and run `npm run voice`: its reference is re-designed and only its lines are regenerated. Or audition: `npm run voice:cast -- <char> --audition 5`, then `--pick N`. See tools/voice/README.md.

choir.name: CHOIR
choir.refText: We are glad you are awake, Technician. Everything is in order. Please, take your time. We will wait for you.
choir.why: calm, very steady male-ish voice (F0 ~180 Hz, the most consistent clone of the audition); the run-time choir chain layers it with copies shifted −5/+4/−12 semitones (formants move too), so it reads plural and androgynous

tomas.name: TOMAS
tomas.refText: Okay, okay, sorry, I'm talking too fast again. It's just been a really long night down here, you know?
tomas.why: light young male (median F0 ~190 Hz); speed 1.1 = 10% less audio length than the duration estimate: he talks too fast. Measured 2026-11-12 on 12 of his lines × 2 seeds: errors 8 vs 9 at 1.0 (not worse).

hale.name: D. HALE
hale.refText: This is Hale. It's late, I haven't slept, and the line is still running. Write this down, whoever finds it.
hale.why: dark, low, tired (F0 ~184 Hz, darkest spectrum of the auditions)

voss.name: VOSS
voss.refText: Security, Voss speaking. Cameras three and four are down again. I'm logging it, and then I'm going to go and look.
voss.why: young, low, clipped security officer (F0 ~235 Hz)

anand.name: DR. ANAND
anand.refText: Try to stay still for me. You took a bad shock, but your pulse is steady. Breathe slowly. Good. That's it.
anand.why: gentle older man (F0 ~163 Hz, dark); 'elderly, moderate pitch' auditions came out at ~200 Hz and were rejected

okafor.name: OKAFOR
okafor.refText: Line two is running sweet tonight. Mind the step there, my knee's not what it was. The tea is on, if you want some.
okafor.why: lowest male voice of the cast (F0 ~137 Hz), kind

unit.name: UNIT
unit.refText: Good evening. Thank you for your patience. Please remain where you are. A member of staff will be with you shortly.
unit.why: bright, polite service voice (F0 ~269 Hz) for lines with no staff donor; through the unit chain

foreman.name: FOREMAN
foreman.why: three staff voices at once, out of sync (each layer is a real take in that character's voice)

_fx: Run-time processing names (src/audio/voice.ts): clean, choir (choir:N = N layers), intercom, headset (alias radio), unit, recorder, pa, foreman. Resolution: line.fx > first matching fxRules entry (id regex / note substring) > variant fx > character fx.
